tests.title: London Private Hire Regulations — Mock Test 1

questions.question: London PHVs may only accept bookings through:
options: Word of mouth at a rank
questions.explanation: All bookings must go through a licensed operator.

questions.question: Pulling up to take a street hail in a PHV is:
questions.explanation: Only licensed taxis may ply for hire.

questions.question: Vehicles licensed as PHVs in London must display:
questions.explanation: PHVs must show TfL-issued discs as required.

questions.question: Operators are responsible for:
options: Recording bookings and assigning licensed drivers
questions.explanation: Operators must keep records of bookings, drivers and vehicles.

questions.question: If you are 'app-on' but parked legally and waiting, you are:
options: Available for pre-booked work via the operator
questions.explanation: Pre-bookings via the licensed operator are lawful.

questions.question: Damage or accidents involving the vehicle must be reported to:
options: Your operator and TfL where required
questions.explanation: Notification rules apply to keep the licence valid.

questions.question: You may not pick up a passenger who has not been:
questions.explanation: Pre-booking via the operator is mandatory.

questions.question: Operating in London without a licence carries penalties of:
options: A fine and possible criminal record
questions.explanation: Unlicensed operation is a criminal offence.
